prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a finished widescreen 16:9 authentication wallpaper for SenomyOS, suitable for a 2560x1440 desktop, no UI drawn into it.
Primary request: original black, ivory and silver metalheart artwork with early-2000s experimental digital-art sensibility, abstract futuristic chrome, liquid-metal curvature and fine sharp sculptural filaments. A dark, precise, elegant operating-system identity.
Composition: a panoramic sculptural field, tangled polished titanium and ceramic-ivory curved blades sweeping along the outer thirds and upper edges, with thin intricate tension lines and soft pearly reflections. The central 35 percent, especially centre-lower area, is quieter charcoal negative space for a compact sign-in form to sit on top. Outer forms may arc inward but do not fill or frame that quiet area with a literal box. Convincing dimensional material, refined asymmetry, intentional light, rich dark values and luminous ivory highlights. Visually authored abstract album-book artwork, no stock sci-fi landscape, no room, no horizon.
Palette: strictly ink-black, charcoal, silver, warm ivory and white; no neon, cyan, purple or saturated colour. Crisp local metal detail with some atmospheric softness, not a uniform blur; runtime UI will apply blur separately.
Constraints: no text, letters, logos, watermarks, faces, figures, hearts as a literal icon, application windows, interface panels, grids, screen borders or built-in vignette frame. Generate the artwork only.
use: SenomyOS configurable authentication background; not a captured desktop
